entities.name: Beledros Witherbloom
entities.description: Black elder dragon of Arcavios and one of the five founders of Strixhaven, master of life and death.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: Institution founded by the five elder dragons to study the five mana dichotomies.

entities.name: Witherbloom College
entities.description: Strixhaven college named in Beledros's honor.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: Plane formed by the merging of the demiplanes Ezroi and Karudis.

entities.name: Ezroi
entities.description: Demiplane that merged with Karudis to form Arcavios.

entities.name: Karudis
entities.description: Demiplane that merged with Ezroi to form Arcavios.

entities.name: Founder Dragons
entities.description: Five dragons hatched from mana vortices who founded Strixhaven.

events.summary: At the birth of Arcavios, Ezroi and Karudis merge and five dragons hatch from luminous spheres of mana.
events.quote: Five particularly powerful vortices of overlapping mana became luminous spheres, from which were hatched five dragons .

events.summary: The dragons, first angered by mortals harnessing magic, come to see that disciplined study is needed and found Strixhaven.
events.quote: the dragons founded an institution devoted to the study of the five mana dichotomies

relations.quote: Beledros Witherbloom is one of the five elder dragons from Arcavios that founded Strixhaven .
